messages:
Devon: quick summary — ran a cross-model perf sweep focused on kernel selection + batching + KV behavior. attached profiling (short) and a few immediate config recs. TL;DR: model-specific kernels matter more than global heuristics for 2-8k contexts.
Yara: can you paste the key numbers? esp. where KV/prefetch flips behavior.
Devon: numbers (median latency, p95 tokens/sec):
- Llama-2-13B: batch 8 -> median 48ms/token, p95 60ms/token, tp 210 tok/s
- Mistral-7B: batch 8 -> median 36ms/token, p95 50ms/token, tp 270 tok/s
- Mixtral-8x7B: batch 8 -> median 42ms/token, p95 78ms/token, tp 230 tok/s
- Qwen-7B: batch 4 -> median 55ms/token, p95 95ms/token, tp 180 tok/s
Devon: interesting bit — when context > 4k, KV cache prefetching hits a regression for Mixtral/Qwen (extra copy + strided access). pprof shows hotspot in kernel_dispatcher memcpy path.
TJ: yeah saw that. kernel selector chooses fused-attn+strided-kv for head_dim<=64. for Qwen head_dim=128 so it falls back, but we still do an extra metadata copy. proposed patch: avoid extra copy when fallback matmul used. small change, big win.
Sam: any numbers for before/after?
Devon: local patch (no opt) -> Mixtral p95 went from 78ms to 60ms on long contexts (8k). Qwen p95 improved 95ms -> 72ms but throughput stable.
Ana: note on RoPE: we tried scale=1.0 vs 0.9 for Mistral. scale=0.9 reduced p95 jitter for long contexts (~8% lower) but slightly lower commit-level perplexity. tradeoff looks fine for strict latency SLOs.
perf-bot: ALERT: regression detected on main@5b2f1a4 — +12% p95 on mixtral long-context tests. linked CI: https://ci.redwood/prof/5b2f1a4
Yara: thanks — that matches the memcpy hotspot. I can run a KV-eviction pattern sweep to see where age-based eviction + prefetch beats LRU. want me to run now?
TJ: please. also I'll add a kernel selection toggle so we can A/B fuse vs unfused behavior per model. flag = `runtime.kernels.fuse_attn_by_headdim` (default: auto).
Sam: OK real ask from product: per-model release recs we can ship with next runtime. Devon can you write a 3-line config for each model?
Devon: sure — initial recs (for runtime v2.3):
- Llama-2-13B: kernels: small-head-optimized; batch_max=16 for throughput workloads; kv_prefetch=true; rope_scale=1.0; fallback_policy=allow_matmul
- Mistral-7B: kernels: quant-friendly (int8 path); batch_max=12; kv_prefetch=true; rope_scale=0.9; prefer_fused_attn=true
- Mixtral-8x7B: kernels: disable_strided_prefetch (workaround); batch_max=8; kv_prefetch=false for >4k contexts; rope_scale=1.0; enable_kernel_flag=false
- Qwen-7B: kernels: large-head path; batch_max=4; kv_eviction=age_based; rope_scale=1.02; prefer_matmul_path=true
Yara: I'll queue a long-tail sweep (1k/2k/4k/8k/16k/32k) for all models with these configs and collect p50/p95/p99 + memory.
TJ: I'll land the kernel selector flag behind a feature gate and add unit perf tests for head_dim boundaries (32/64/96/128).
Ana: note to ship_notes: call out RoPE scale tradeoffs + that we intentionally pick slightly lower quality for Mistral when latency SLOs prioritized.
Sam: checklist for release:
- land kernel flag + perf tests (TJ)
- KV copy fix + CI sweep (Devon/Yara)
- long-tail sweep results + artifacts (Yara)
- config blobs for Console dropdowns (Devon)
- release note blurb (Ana)
Sam: anything blocking?
Devon: main blocker = one more full-run with KV prefetch off on Mixtral at 16k to validate memory tail. if that looks good we can stage rollout.
Yara: starting the run now, will post results in thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
TJ: will monitor perf dashboard and mute alerts for the experimental flag.
Devon: thanks all. follow-ups: when Yara posts results we'll pin next steps and flip on the per-model defaults in staging. :thumbsup:
